<script lang="ts">
  import { WheelPicker } from '@larose-ui/svelte';

  const columns = [
    {
      id: 'hour',
      label: 'Hour',
      options: [
        { value: '09', label: '09' },
        { value: '10', label: '10' },
        { value: '11', label: '11' },
      ],
    },
    {
      id: 'minute',
      label: 'Minute',
      options: [
        { value: '00', label: '00' },
        { value: '15', label: '15' },
        { value: '30', label: '30' },
      ],
    },
  ];
  let value = $state({ hour: '09', minute: '00' });
</script>

<WheelPicker {columns} {value} onChange={(next) => (value = next)} aria-label="Time" />
